hypothesis: The nonuniform discrete 101-cosmology search may contribute to cosmology-dependent normal false alarms. Check this separately from conditional-flow modeling error.
models: Frozen R3 four-noise-view, 30000-update summary flows, initialization seeds 0, 1 and 2; best checkpoints already selected on normal validation.
controls: Energy at the known true cosmology for NORMAL diagnostic maps only; never available to a deployed detector.
Minimum energy over the original 101 training cosmologies, matching the deployed summary component.
Bounded continuous per-map minimization of the same energy, initialized from the four best grid points and constrained to the training cosmology convex hull.

optimization.network_weights: Frozen; only each map's two physical conditioning coordinates are optimized.
optimization.coordinates: The model's fixed standardized Omega_m and S8 coordinates.
optimization.method: Projected Adam with deterministic cosine-decayed step size; retain the best energy along each path including its original grid start.
optimization.limitation: This is approximate constrained minimization, not a proof of the global optimum or a likelihood-ratio test. Allowing interpolated cosmologies enlarges the accepted family.

validation.pilot: Two normal validation maps from every cosmology: numerical checks, comparison to the original predictor, 64/128-step convergence, supported-hull constraints, and singleton/order independence.
validation.reference: A fixed dense grid within the same convex hull on a subset of normal pilot maps; it is a numerical diagnostic, not ground truth for the optimum.
validation.evaluation: Normal validation/calibration/audit sets, followed by all previously used synthetic families. Report normal coverage by known parameters, energy reduction and regressions in detection power.
validation.public_test: No public test inputs or leaderboard feedback used in this experiment.
validation.existing_artifacts: Candidates 04, 05, 06 and 07 remain frozen and unchanged.

scope: Authorized erdos-3242 lab only; RAM-backed research directories; no production changes.
